title: Host QNN/QNC scalar initialization, transport, and UDM boundary source review

repository.head: 74dcfb368212e2d6983004ff81804099c09ee444
repository.scope_note: Pinned PR154 tree. No assertion about later/unpinned changes.

registry_and_initialization: Registry declares QNN/NetCDF QNCCN and QNC/NetCDF QNCLOUD as number concentrations with units # kg(-1) (Registry.EM_COMMON 536-545; internal QNC variable similarly at line 122). This is the declared interface, not independent proof of every producer's numerical basis.

The namelist ccn_conc default is 1.0E8 with units # m-3 (Registry.EM_COMMON 2701). In start_em, f_qnn initializes QNN from grid%ccn_conc when the scalar maximum is <1; NSSL may set ccn_conc=nssl_cccn/1.225 or zero (start_em.F 1796-1811). Other listed schemes are NO OP in this block. This is a distinct route from the option-37 driver initialization.

On first timestep, the microphysics driver can initialize full-memory QNN_CURR directly to ccn_conc (module_microphysics_driver.F 928-931). In the UDM branch, the call passes ccn_preinitialized=.true. and input_density_is_dry=.true. (2836-2895), so the optional UDM timestep-1 CCN initialization is disabled for that call; UDM's omitted-argument defaults would initialize NN and interpret DEN as non-dry otherwise (module_mp_udm.F 326-338).

UDM clamps its first CCN mode to [ccnmin,ccnmax] (module_mp_udm.F 891-901); constants are labeled m-3 in the source. This is a consumer-side clamp, not evidence that Registry prognostic QNN has been converted or that all QNN routes use volume units.

QNC can be vertically interpolated from qnc_gc to P_QNC when flag_qnc is active (module_initialize_real.F 2027-2035). The later generic number initialization path inspected for selected schemes excludes UDM, so this source block does not establish a universal QNC initialization conversion. Restart/other input producer authority remains unresolved.
transport_and_boundaries: solve_em routes each scalar through rk_scalar_tend and rk_update_scalar; QNN and QNC are scalar indices and are passed to the microphysics driver (solve_em.F 3998-4000). rk_scalar_tend selects positive-definite, monotonic, or other advect_scalar implementations according to runtime options and then includes diffusion (module_em.F 1096-1442).

The advection procedures form fluxes from mass-coupled staggered winds and scalar values; source comments explicitly describe the ADT equation as rho-to-rho*q (module_advect_em.F, e.g. 3260-3277 and 3387-3388). Thus the transported scalar follows the host's mass-weighted tracer equation. The chosen stencil/configuration determines the actual face flux; a scalar-only update is not an advection test.

rk_update_scalar multiplies advect_tend by msfty, adds scalar tendencies, defines muold=mu_old+mu_base and munew=mu_new+mu_base, then updates q by ((c1*muold+c2)*q_old + dt*tendency)/(c1*munew+c2) (module_em.F 1587-1799, especially 1722-1724 and 1773). With zero tendency this preserves the source-defined weighted amount across a changing mass state. This is host mass coupling/decoupling, not conversion to a volume number density.

For specified QNN boundaries, solve_em calls flow_dep_bdy_qnn with ccn_conc and no density argument (solve_em.F 3054-3059). The routine writes ccn_conc directly at inflow and copies the interior scalar at outflow (module_bc.F 2460-2583). Boundary injection therefore follows the volume-labelled ccn_conc route; whether this is intended for a #kg-1 transported field is not resolved by this source alone.
findings.contract_assessment: There is a concrete source seam: Registry describes QNN/QNC as #kg-1, while selected initialization and QNN boundary inflow assign ccn_conc labelled #m-3 without a visible conversion, and the host scalar equation mass-weights its prognostic scalar. This is a testable interface inconsistency candidate, not a proven production bug: runtime route/configuration and intended storage policy must be captured/authenticated before a physical conclusion.

stage_a_actual_update_procedure.setup: Use a small manufactured interior domain; one scalar, one RK stage, zero advect_tend and zero sc_tend; choose unequal positive old/new dry column mass (mu_old+mu_base != mu_new+mu_base), and explicit c1/c2.
stage_a_actual_update_procedure.oracle: For the selected update, compare Mnew*qnew to Mold*qold, where Mold=c1*(mu_old+mu_base)+c2 and Mnew=c1*(mu_new+mu_base)+c2, using the source update ordering. With zero tendency, the algebraic update implies equality up to floating-point evaluation. Also verify qnew=(Mold/Mnew)*qold.
stage_a_actual_update_procedure.meaning: Confirms the actual host update's mass-weighted scalar behavior under changing dry mass; it cannot establish whether the incoming numerical QNN/QNC value represents #kg-1 or #m-3.

stage_b_actual_closed_flux_procedure.setup: Use a tiny periodic horizontal grid, fixed vertical mass, zero physics/diffusion and a documented supported stencil/order. Capture the actual face fluxes and use source map factors/areas and layer mass weights.
stage_b_actual_closed_flux_procedure.oracle: Independently sum finite-volume flux divergence over the periodic domain; net boundary flux is zero, so the dry-mass/map-area weighted scalar total must be conserved through the selected stage. Include all face metrics and the actual RK coefficients; do not compare an unweighted sum.
stage_b_actual_closed_flux_procedure.meaning: Confirms scalar transport's discrete conservative-flux implementation, not number-population units.

smallest_discriminating_test.basis_discriminator: At the same exact UDM call boundary, record QNN/QNC immediately before and after the UDM call together with DEN, timestep, input flags, and initialization/boundary-route provenance. Compare an otherwise identical controlled state at two dry-density values: a declared mass-specific scalar should remain #kg-1 and its physical volume concentration changes with dry density; a volume concentration should require an explicit density conversion before/after mass-weighted transport. This requires a purpose-built source/unit fixture; this review does not execute it or select a physical policy.

limits: No compiler, model, solver, reader, or raw scientific-array access was performed.

The task only reviewed host QNN/QNC initialization and scalar transport boundary. It does not authenticate restart/input producer units, quantify runtime route activation, or validate UDM's internal number processes/radius formulas.
Do not infer a universal density multiplier or change production semantics from the source seam. The conserved-flux test and the producer/storage-unit authority question are separate gates.
